name: Shree Refrigerations Ltd
title: Shree Refrigerations Ltd - 544458 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue roughly 50%+ higher with H2 EBITDA margin 26.3% on operating leverage, but a 250-day receivables and 370-day working capital cycle still tie up cash; FY27 guidance is 20-24% EBITDA margin.

capex.quote: we don't expect a major CapEx involvement for the next couple of years at least

triggers.label: Working capital days 570 → 370
triggers.quote: our working capital base, which has successfully came down from 570 days to 370 days

triggers.label: EBITDA margin guided 20-24%
triggers.quote: we expect that our EBITDA margin will remain somewhere between 20% to 24%

triggers.label: Hanbarwadi capacity online June
triggers.quote: the plant will be up and running by June

triggers.label: Metal inflation beyond fixed-price bids
triggers.quote: But metal today is going beyond every inflation calculation

guidance.quote: we expect that our EBITDA margin will remain somewhere between 20% to 24%
we will continue to grow 40% C AGR rate for three to five years easily

guidance.value: reference installation FY27; major revenue FY28
guidance.quote: we expect a major revenue coming in from a data centre in FY28

guidance.metric: Spares and service share of revenue
guidance.quote: we are continuously working on it to increase our spa res and service revenue to 15% to 20%

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue/ PAT trajectory (net profit INR13 cr to INR21 cr, as guided in H1 call)
prior_guidance_check.quote: our net profit has been increased from INR13 crores to INR21 crores, as has been guided in the earning call of first half

prior_guidance_check.metric: H2 EBITDA margin guided ~22% in H1 call
prior_guidance_check.quote: as guided in the first half earning call, we have achieved the EBITDA margin of 22%

prior_guidance_check.metric: INR1,000 cr sales and INR120-130 cr PAT by FY30-31 (Nov 2025 deck)
prior_guidance_check.quote: INR1,000 crore is the ladder which we are here in next 5 years and it will happen, sir.

red_flags.label: Receivables 250 days; WC 370 days
red_flags.quote: Total receivable days were 350 days last year. It has come down to 250 days

red_flags.label: Lumpy H1/H2 skew, low visibility
red_flags.quote: H1 was really very, very muted and H2 was a blockbuster

red_flags.label: Guidance on FY27 excludes data centre; management avoids quarterly reporting
red_flags.quote: our guidance for FY27 is without data centre

evasions.topic: Peak revenue from existing assets / capacity
evasions.quote: What is the peak revenue which we can generate out of our infrastructure? This data we have already given last time also.

evasions.topic: Growth math to INR1,000 cr target
evasions.quote: But that doesn't work in business, sir.
